resources.string: The game was removed from the library.
This system needs the files below. Import them in Settings › BIOS.
Couldn\'t open %s. Link the folder again in Settings.
%1$s opens the game file directly and can\'t read it from a linked folder. Allow access to all files so the app can hand it the real file.
The core couldn\'t be loaded on this device.
The core couldn\'t open this file. It may be corrupted or from another region/format.
Some cores for this console need a BIOS that is missing or invalid. Import it in Settings › BIOS:
Vulkan didn\'t start on this device: the core is drawing on the CPU instead.
%1$s closed the game more than once with Vulkan on this device: it now draws on the CPU. Vulkan can be turned back on in the console page.
%1$s was updated to its newest version.
Your device doesn\'t support the OpenGL ES version this core requires.
Failed to read or write the save state.
Still a black screen? %1$s may not run this game. Check the console BIOS in Settings › BIOS or, if available, pick another core in the game details.
Couldn\'t capture the screen to translate. Try again.
The game is still starting. Try again in a moment.
%1$s can\'t save states safely. Save inside the game, on the memory card.
The autosave doesn\'t match this core and wasn\'t loaded. It was kept as a backup.
Speeds up emulation to skip dialogue and grinding.
This core has no configurable options.
Tap an option to cycle its value. Some changes only apply after restarting the game.
